privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection
privacy.subtitle: Our foundational commitment to zero camera surveillance.
privacy.engineBody: Ingredient analysis runs against a bundled additive taxonomy on your phone. Photos you capture are never uploaded — only barcode numbers and text you choose to look up are sent to Open Food Facts or public web sources for product matching.
privacy.trackingTitle: No Ad Tracking or Identity Fingerprinting
privacy.trackingBody: VegTrace does not collect device identifiers, advertising IDs, or GPS locations.
privacy.storageTitle: Scan History Stays On Your Device
privacy.storageBody: Your scan history and cached product records are stored only in on-device app storage, and your dietary preferences and language in encrypted secure storage. By default, history never leaves this device. Signed-in users can opt in to sync non-identifiable scan results (barcode and verdict) to their account — ingredient text is never uploaded. Barcode and keyword lookups query Open Food Facts and, as a fallback, public web sources; your IP address is visible to those services when a lookup runs.

profile.persistNote: Settings persist locally in device storage.
profile.savedBanner: Dietary preferences updated & saved to local storage.
profile.dietBody: Determines how ingredients and trace additives are evaluated across all products.
profile.dietStrictBody: Flags slaughterhouse by-products, carmine, bone char, and gelatin.
profile.dietLactoBody: Allows traditional milk and dairy; flags slaughter additives.
profile.dietVeganBody: Flags all animal derivatives including dairy, honey, beeswax, and shellac.
profile.dietFlexibleBody: Allows traditional dairy and eggs; flags slaughter additives and meat.
profile.strictBody: Automatically escalate "Source Undisclosed" (e.g. E471 without plant certificate) to Non-Vegetarian.
profile.watchlistBody: Always flag these specific E-numbers in the product breakdown.
profile.syncHint: Pushes prefs and scans to the cloud when signed in

onboarding.heroBody: Food labels frequently conceal animal fats under obscure numbers like E471. VegTrace verifies supply chain disclosures rather than blindly guessing.
onboarding.ocrBody: Instant camera recognition runs strictly on your phone without uploading raw photos to third-party servers.
onboarding.evidenceBody: Verdicts rely on authoritative biochemical taxonomies and manufacturer statements—never hallucinated by generative models.
onboarding.sourceBody: Dual-origin additives (plant or animal) are transparently categorized as Source Undisclosed until verified.

ingredient.originsBody: How this additive is industrially synthesized worldwide.
ingredient.plantBody: Extracted from crude vegetable triglycerides (soybean, palm, sunflower). 100% vegetarian compliant.
ingredient.animalBody: Derived by hydrolysis of commercial slaughterhouse bovine tallow, pork lard, or animal tissues.
ingredient.syntheticBody: Synthesized in laboratory or petrochemical reactors without biological animal feedstock.
ingredient.mineralBody: Inorganic mineral salt obtained through mining or brine evaporation.
ingredient.evidenceBody: Cross-referenced public databases, regulatory filings, and customer queries.
ingredient.unknownBody: "{{code}}" is not in VegTrace's on-device additive registry, so no verdict or evidence trail exists for it. Known ≠ Assumed — no data is invented.

verification.title: Verification Pipeline
verification.subtitle: How VegTrace verified the ingredients and computed the verdict.
verification.stepOffBody: Retrieves product metadata and package ingredient listing.
verification.stepOcrBody: Extracts E-numbers and INS codes from package text on your phone.
verification.stepKbBody: Matches additives against the bundled dual-origin taxonomy.
verification.stepWebBody: Checks manufacturer pages and reference sources for disclosure.
verification.disclosureFound: Manufacturer disclosure found in product text
verification.disclosureMissing: No manufacturer disclosure found in product text
verification.noEvidence: No external verification records retrieved yet. Origin evaluated using on-device biochemical taxonomies.

about.principleBody: If an ingredient or food additive can originate from either animal fats or vegetable oils and the packaging does not disclose the certified source, VegTrace reports Source Undisclosed, not assumed vegetarian or non-vegetarian.
about.insBody: International Numbering System for food additives and biochemical derivation pathways.
about.zeroBody: Camera frames and scanned label photos are processed on-device and are never uploaded to remote servers.
about.disclaimerBody: VegTrace provides algorithmic classification based on published biochemical taxonomies and manufacturer packaging text. It is not medical or religious certification advice. Always consult manufacturer representatives directly for severe allergies or certified requirements.
